challenge: The application suffered from slow data loading and poor query performance, negatively impacting user experience.
action:
Restructured database and optimized queries using indexes
• Implemented caching techniques using Redis
• Improved API performance by reducing data payload and adding pagination
• Used React Query for state management and optimized loading
result:
• Improved data loading speed by 85%
• Reduced API response time from 3 seconds to under 0.5 seconds
• Increased user satisfaction and retention rate by 25%

challenge: The e-commerce application had a non-responsive UI and poor component reusability, increasing development time and complexity.
action:
Built reusable React components using Props and State management
• Implemented fully responsive design using Bootstrap and CSS Flexbox
• Improved application performance using React.memo and useCallback
• Created cart state management system using Context API
result:
Reduced new feature development time by 40%
• Improved user experience across all devices
• Achieved 60% component reusability across different pages

challenge: The application suffered from poor code organization and collaboration difficulties due to lack of effective version control.
action:
Implemented Git/GitHub workflow using Git Flow strategy
• Conducted code reviews to ensure code quality
• Restructured project using Separation of Concerns principle
• Documented APIs and handled them using Axios
result:
Improved team collaboration efficiency by 50%
• Reduced bugs by 35%
• Accelerated development process by 30%
